messages.subject: Extracting warm up samples
parts:
I apologize of this question is trivial.

I fit a stan model to my data using 4 chains with 1000 iterations and a warm up of a 100 iterations.
When I extract the samples using the extract function (with permute = TRUE) I get 3600 samples per each parameter so I understand that the warm up samples per each chain are not returned. (I also tried to specify inc_warmup = TRUE which didn't change anything)
Am I right? If so how can I extract the warm up samples? If not where am I wrong?

Thanks a lot,
rubi

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Extracting warm up samples
parts:
There's an inc_warmup flag and also a permuted flag.
The default for the former is false and the latter is true.
There's no point in including warmup and permuting, so make
sure to set permute=FALSE when setting inc_warmup=TRUE.

By default, traceplot will include the warmup samples.

But you can't use them for inference, which is why they're
not returned by default by extract.

- Bob
